subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should existing macOS users start seeing assistant reasoning and tool activity by default after this upgrade, or should the new toggle preserve the previously hidden default?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a persisted user-visible default; automated tests cannot determine the desired privacy and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve Hidden Default
options.body: Add the trace toggle but default it off unless users explicitly enable it.

options.title: Adopt Default-On Traces
options.body: Keep traces enabled by default and explicitly accept and document the upgrade behavior for existing users.

recommendation.title: Preserve Hidden Default
recommendation.body: Add the trace toggle but default it off unless users explicitly enable it.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the proposed macOS chat integration and is the strongest available owner for the native-chat default choice.
